text: Generate validated aim proposals with the selected loop model
description: Add a read-only proposeAimSubtree backend operation that reuses the selected loop's provider/model/base URL and stored API key, sends only transcript plus compact selected-parent context, exposes no tools, generates a bounded recursive decomposition without IDs, assigns draft-local IDs server-side, and validates the final shared AimProposal. Keep generation separate from approval persistence.

status.comment: Read-only model-backed proposal generation is implemented and internally verified; awaiting Felix's acceptance and a live configured-model trial.

reflection: Added aim.proposeAimSubtree and a provider-neutral generator that reuses the selected loop's provider/model/base URL plus its stored secret (NVIDIA_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_API_KEY, or LOOP_API_KEY). The model receives only the transcript and compact selected-parent titles/descriptions, has no tools, and emits an ID-free bounded tree. The server assigns deterministic draft-local IDs and validates the final shared AimProposal; existing parent/phase references are checked first. This supports Kimi through an OpenRouter or OpenAI-compatible loop configuration without Kimi-specific code. Verification: generator tests cover structure/ID assignment and shared-depth rejection; full backend tests 66/66, backend build, frontend type-check, and git diff check pass. Live inference intentionally remains unclaimed because it requires the configured provider credential.
